name: How long does interior wall repair typically take?
description: Repair time varies; small jobs take hours, while extensive repairs can take one to three days. It depends on the damage's extent and complexity.

mainEntity.name: How long does interior wall repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of interior wall repair depends on the extent of the damage and the number of walls needing attention. Small patch jobs, like repairing a few nail holes or minor cracks, might take a few hours. More extensive repairs, such as large drywall sections or multiple areas with water damage, could span one to three days, including drying and finishing stages. We provide a time estimate after assessing the specific project requirements.
